name: 85029 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85029 (Phoenix) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85029 (Phoenix) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85029 (Phoenix) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
